description: Represent a detector an analyzer can use.

category.description: The upstream engine's own category for the detection, when it has one (for instance 'Personal Information'). It only helps browsing detectors: policies match on the group and the name.
category.title: category

friendlyName.description: The friendly name of the detection.
friendlyName.title: friendlyName

group.description: The group the detection belongs to.
group.title: group

label.description: The label returned by the model.
label.title: label

positional.description: Tell if the detection is positional.
positional.title: positional

type.description: Who authored the detection, when the upstream engine says: 'predefined' (shipped by the vendor), 'custom' (defined by the organization) or 'ai_classifier' (shipped by the vendor, backed by a model). Empty for analyzers with no upstream engine.
type.title: type

title: Detector
